title: ARC-VLN: Adaptive Recursive Computing-based Visual-Language Navigation
abstract: arXiv:2611.18696v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Efficient aerial visual-language navigation (VLN) requires reducing model storage and inference costs while maintaining instruction-conditioned action prediction. We present ARC-VLN, a token-type-aware recursive computation framework built on a language backbone with shared parameters. ARC-VLN retains full-depth computation for text and action tokens while adaptively selecting exit depths for visual tokens. Representations of early-exiting visual tokens are retained, and active-token compaction shortens the sequences processed by subsequent recursive blocks. translated_title: ARC-VLN：基于自适应递归计算的视觉-语言导航
translated_abstract: 高效的空中视觉-语言导航（VLN）需要在保持基于指令条件的动作预测能力的同时，降低模型的存储与推理成本。我们提出了ARC-VLN，一个构建在共享参数语言骨干网络之上的、感知token类型的递归计算框架。ARC-VLN对文本token和动作token保留全深度计算，同时为视觉token自适应地选择退出深度；提前退出的视觉token的表征会被保留，并且通过活跃token压缩来缩短后续递归块所处理的序列长度。为缓解路由坍缩到单一退出深度的问题，我们设计了一种专门的学习策略，鼓励模型将视觉token分布到多个退出深度上。在OpenFly的Test-Seen和Test-Unseen子集上，ARC-VLN在所有对比方法中取得了最低的导航误差以及最高的成功率和按路径长度加权的成功率，同时降低了推理成本。
tldr: ARC-VLN提出了一种感知token类型的自适应递归计算框架，对文本和动作token保留全深度计算而对视觉token自适应选择退出深度，从而在OpenFly基准上以更低的存储与推理成本实现了最优的导航性能。
en_tdlr: ARC-VLN is a token-type-aware adaptive recursive computing framework that keeps full-depth computation for text and action tokens while adaptively selecting exit depths for visual tokens, achieving state-of-the-art navigation performance on OpenFly benchmarks with reduced storage and inference costs.
